- The repository's `pnpm-lock.yaml` pins `@sw-code:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com` for the `@sw-code` scope. This is GitHub Packages' npm registry. Let me check whether `@sw-code` scoped packages are actually external dependencies (not workspace), which would require a GITHUB_TOKEN for npm.

Let me check whether any of the `@sw-code` packages in the lockfile are actually resolved from the registry (external), or whether they are all workspace.
